comments.text:
biggest danger to GW2 is the "balance team"  because the stories are great,  most of the game mechanics are fine.  Too many layers of complexity for newer folks but happens with a decade old game.   Nope the one consistent team that loses the most players is the balance team. 

Your gears stats may not change  but if they add classes or weapons or gear...   You will come back and the performance of that gear will be lacking.   Cause they always over tune new things to get people to go and get them.   Then nerf things that have Nothing to do with what they added.  

I love the game and play it from time to time.  Though I try to give a realistic understanding of the pain points.  To be sure im not disagreeing,  we have had those issues.  I am saying get legendary gear ASAP or pay regularly out the nose for new rune and gear setups.
comments.author: @vaddick
